### P006 non-futures cash-market scope decision (project policy)

For P006 in normal impulses only, the project elects to use the strict orthodox-end proposition stated in Volume 5 (00:00:46.560-00:01:13.280) and Volume 10 (00:30:52.600-00:31:08.400) within a future separately approved evaluator restricted to explicitly identified non-futures cash-market instruments. This is an explicit project scope/adjudication choice, not a conclusion that excluding futures by itself resolves the source conflict.

Preserve the Volume 2 futures qualification (00:16:58.520-00:17:14.520), its apparent-overlap example (00:06:51.350-00:07:30.160), and the approved book's recorded page-31 futures lead with their existing classifications and conflict history. Futures and unverified instrument/price-series scope remain unresolved. Do not infer a numerical allowance, substitute a cash series for futures, or declare what the qualification meant. This decision establishes neither general seminar precedence nor book precedence and does not transfer the P005 policy to P006.

This scope choice supplies no orthodox-end recognition or certification authority, equality/touch convention, price domain or numerical tolerance, observation-field mapping, completion event, snapshot timing, or machine predicate. Hypothesis-bound endpoints remain hypotheses. Whole-path territory guidance remains nonfatal and separate. P006 implementation, structural certification and positive family certification remain unavailable until those independent requirements receive separate authority and approval.

options.formal_adoption: Requires a separately authorized protected policy edit and computed update to only its PACKAGE_MANIFEST entry. The current P005 API pins the whole SOURCE_POLICY hash: policy adoption alone would make it fail closed until a separately approved Runtime/Kernel hash-admission transition and verification preserved P005 semantics. Neither adoption nor that transition is authorized here; no prospective manifest hash is asserted.
